name: lineage crosses a process only by an explicit carrier
why: A subprocess shares no memory, so nothing propagates implicitly and nothing should pretend to: auto-pickling a context across a fork is the magic that fails silently. The SDK must offer a deliberate way to carry the credential and re-enter it on the other side, and this pins that it produces the same evidence as an in-process call. The matching negative — a worker given no carrier runs unenriched — is case 11's middle record.
